pending_part_2.title: PART 2: Why Did They Bury the Temple? #shorts #mystery
pending_part_2.description: PART 2 (FINALE): Ground-penetrating radar reveals Göbekli Tepe was intentionally sealed beneath millions of tons of earth. #shorts #viral #mystery
pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we saw how Göbekli Tepe rewrote the timeline of human engineering by over seven thousand years. But the greatest enigma is not how they built it; it is what they did next. Ground-penetrating radar revealed that after centuries of sacred rituals, the builders did not abandon their monument. They systematically backfilled the entire megalithic complex with hundreds of thousands of tons of dirt and animal bones, creating an artificial mountain to seal it away from the world. Why would an ancient society spend generations burying their most sacred architectural marvel? Recent archaeo-astronomy studies suggest the pillars align precisely with the catastrophic Younger Dryas comet impact that devastated Earth twelve thousand years ago. Was Göbekli Tepe a celestial time capsule warning future generations of a cosmic threat?
